title: Global tensor pullback mates are isomorphisms
statement: For a scheme X and an adjunction P ⊣ Γ(X,-), the mate of the global-sections unit map and the mates of the section tensor maps under the adjunction are isomorphisms.

proof.text: The unit sheaf represents global sections: identify morphisms from the unit with compatible sections, and compatible sections with evaluation at the top open. A linear map from the rank-one free global-section module is determined by its value at 1. These two equivalences and the adjunction identify precomposition with the unit mate as a bijection on all outgoing Hom sets. The coyoneda criterion gives invertibility of the unit mate.

Fix B. The tensor mates define a natural transformation from (tensorRight B) composed with P to P composed with tensorRight(P B). Prove naturality using adjunction naturality and the section identity whiskerRight_app_tmulSection, evaluated on pure tensors. Both functors preserve colimits: P is a left adjoint, and tensoring is a left adjoint in these symmetric closed categories.

At A=R, compose the tensor mate with the unit mate tensored with P B, followed by the sheaf left unitor. Transpose through the adjunction and evaluate on r tensor b. The identity unit_R followed by globalSections(unitMate)=unitSectionsEquiv and the section formula for the left unitor show both sides equal r times unit_B(b). Thus this composite is P of the module left unitor. Since the other factors are isomorphisms, the tensor mate at (R,B) is an isomorphism.

Apply the rank-one free generator criterion to the preceding natural transformation to conclude invertibility at every A. Combine with the proved unit-mate assertion. This route does not construct a pullback from the global-sections point and does not need a lax monoidal structure on global sections.

proof_origin.place: rank-one coproduct/cokernel argument, combined with TensorSection.unitSectionsEquiv and leftUnitor_hom_app_tmulSection

theorem globalTensorPullback_mates_isIso
    (P : ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤)) ⥤
      SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    (adj : P ⊣ RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace) :
    IsIso ((adj.homEquiv (𝟙_ _) (𝟙_ _)).symm
      (ModuleCat.ofHom (unitSectionsEquiv (X := X) ⊤).toLinearMap)) ∧
    ∀ A B : ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤)),
      IsIso ((adj.homEquiv _ _).symm
        ((adj.unit.app A ⊗ₘ adj.unit.app B) ≫
          moduleCup_sectionTensorMap X (P.obj A) (P.obj B)))
